Finish and preserve the attempt, then review

Unit 1 · Week 16 · Lesson 2 · Suggested 55-minute plan; adjust to local timing.

Prepare: Continue the preserved attempt for 15 working minutes before any question-specific model or key. Stop and preserve the original responses before revealing feedback. Record actual combined time and prior exposure. Later corrections are supported; a changed retry is separate evidence. This split classroom activity is not a continuous formal examination. For practice use unit1-practice-paper.md, unit1-practice-answers.md only after closure, and unit1-practice-record.md. For a school task use only the school-issued materials.

Suggested answers are teacher guidance, not extra assessment tasks. These notes are public.

Purpose and attempt conditions

Timed formative practice, then feedback: Continue the preserved attempt for 15 working minutes before any question-specific model or key. Stop and preserve the original responses before revealing feedback. Record actual combined time and prior exposure. Later corrections are supported; a changed retry is separate evidence. This split classroom activity is not a continuous formal examination.

Questions-only practice paper · Attempt, feedback and retry record

1. Finish the attempt before feedback

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Continuation and exposure check

Check any exposure or help since Lesson 1. If the key has been viewed, label affected work repeat/supported; do not present it as a fresh continuation. This is public formative practice.

2. Independent continuation: 15 minutes

Suggested time: 15 minutes

Instructional strategy: Timed formative continuation

Suggested remaining working allowance 15 minutes, giving 55 working minutes across the two sessions after 5 reading minutes. Record actual duration; if a smaller section was selected, record that scope. No answer demonstration precedes this window.

3. Stop and preserve all original responses

Suggested time: 3 minutes

Instructional strategy: Attempt closure before reveal

This is the reveal boundary. Before advancing, every learner must preserve the original; if some are still attempting, hold here and keep examples/keys closed. A teacher who extends time must record it before feedback. Work completed after seeing feedback is supported correction, not independent completion.

4. Feedback phase: compare, do not overwrite

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Post-attempt feedback

Feedback starts only after closure. The reference key is public and allows equivalent valid reasoning; diagrams require teacher judgement. Record any self-check as practice evidence, not an official mark or grade prediction.

5. Post-attempt Q3 trace

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Post-attempt worked explanation

This same-paper worked example is intentionally after the closed attempt. At i=1 the best remains 0; at i=2 equality does not replace the first maximum. Any new original-paper response written now is supported. Do not reuse it as fresh diagnostic evidence.

6. Post-attempt Q9 explanation

Suggested time: 8 minutes

Instructional strategy: Explained comparison after closure

After closure, pair Application with HTTPS/web service, Transport with TCP, Internet with IP and Network with Ethernet/Wi-Fi. Accept coherent alternatives. Keep the explanation separate from the original response and identify whether the issue was knowledge or interpreting the prompt.

7. Changed retry: close the key

Suggested time: 7 minutes

Instructional strategy: Changed independent retry

Key closed: first-maximum index 1, maximum 9, total 21. Changed values provide a new attempt but immediate transfer after teaching is not proof of durable mastery. If support is needed, label it and schedule another later changed retry.

8. Keep the evidence phases separate

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Evidence review and next teaching step

Use unit1-practice-record.md. Do not finish original questions after explanations and call that independent. Schedule a delayed changed retry in the existing revision/support time; no new graded task or homework requirement is added.
